caption: The drawing depicts two metallic cowbells placed against a light beige background. The bell on the left is shown upright, rectangular with slightly rounded edges, and has a dark brown and rust-colored surface with areas of light bluish-gray highlights suggesting worn metal. This bell features a simple, squared handle at the top, and is decorated on the front with a raised star-shaped element above a small crescent-shaped hook or ornament. The bell on the right is shown lying on its side, revealing a hollow, dark interior and the clapper (striker) mechanism inside, which consists of a rounded, ball-like piece attached to a simple bracket. The exterior of this bell has a similar brown, rusty texture with some lighter blue-gray patches, and rivet details are visible along one seam. Both bells share a weathered, aged appearance, and the drawing’s composition focuses on describing the shapes, details, and textures of the objects.
title: Cow Bell #6 (With Star)
